2530530.long_comment: It's possible that the Pacers are resting the veteran point guard. Saturday's meeting with the Hawks is his next chance to make his preseason debut.
2530530.name: T.J. McConnell
2530530.short_comment: McConnell (undisclosed) won't play in Wednesday's preseason game against Minnesota, per Tony East of Forbes.com.

2580365.long_comment: Nance has a chance to make his preseason debut Saturday against the Hawks. The veteran big man signed a one-year deal with the Pacers over the summer and is penciled in as the No. 2 center behind Ivica Zubac.
2580365.name: Larry Nance Jr.
2580365.short_comment: Nance (hamstring) practiced Friday, per Tony East of Forbes.com.

2990969.long_comment: Niang is among several Warriors rotation players who will remain home for the second half of a preseason back-to-back. The veteran forward has been working primarily with Golden State's second unit during training camp and should have another opportunity to play Saturday against Sacramento.
2990969.name: Georges Niang
2990969.short_comment: Niang (rest) won't travel with the Warriors for Wednesday's preseason game against Portland, Dalton Johnson of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.

3078576.long_comment: The Celtics appear to be resting their starters for this exhibition. Mike Conley is starting at point guard Thursday.
3078576.name: Derrick White
3078576.short_comment: White (rest) isn't in line to play Thursday against Cleveland, Zack Cox of the Boston Herald reports.

3102530.long_comment: Nurkic will begin the 2026-27 season on the sidelines, and given the tricky nature of foot injuries for big men, it wouldn't be shocking to see his absence extend beyond this initial four-week window. Jaren Jackson will likely spend more time at center while Nurkic is out, and there will be more minutes available for Jaxson Hayes and Mo Bamba.
3102530.name: Jusuf Nurkic
3102530.short_comment: Nurkic will miss at least the next four weeks due to a partial plantar plate tear of second toe in right foot, Chris Haynes of NBA TV reports.

3102531.long_comment: The Warriors still aren't ready to offer up a return timeline for Porzingis, who's battling an undisclosed issue. The big man carries plenty of upside on a per-game basis in the later rounds of fantasy drafts, but he's reached the 60-game mark just one time in the past eight regular seasons.
3102531.name: Kristaps Porzingis
3102531.short_comment: Porzingis (undisclosed) remains out indefinitely, per Anthony Slater of ESPN.com.

3134903.long_comment: Payton is among several rotation players Golden State is holding out Wednesday during a preseason back-to-back. The veteran guard remains in the mix for a reserve role after appearing in a career-high 73 games during the 2025-26 regular season.
3134903.name: Gary Payton II
3134903.short_comment: Payton (rest) is out for Wednesday's preseason game against the Trail Blazers, Dalton Johnson of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.

3138160.long_comment: Martin's next chance to suit up will come during Sunday's rematch against the Rockets in China. The veteran forward enters 2026-27 as part of a crowded Dallas wing rotation, which could make consistent playing time difficult to secure.
3138160.name: Caleb Martin
3138160.short_comment: Martin won't play in Friday's preseason game against the Rocket due to an illness.

3155942.long_comment: After supplying four points (1-2 FG, 0-1 3Pt, 2-2 FT), three rebounds and three assists in 10 minutes during Monday's preseason-opening loss to the Lakers, Sabonis will be held out of Thursday's contest for undisclosed reasons. The big man's next opportunity to suit up in the preseason will come Saturday against Golden State.
3155942.name: Domantas Sabonis
3155942.short_comment: Sabonis (undisclosed) has been ruled out for Thursday's preseason matchup with the Lakers, Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

3202.long_comment: According to coach Ime Udoka, Durant was initially scheduled to play only the first half Friday but requested additional minutes to build chemistry with Fred VanVleet and his other new teammates. The veteran forward's absence Sunday appears to be a planned precaution rather than an injury-related setback, and Houston should have additional minutes available for its other wings and forwards
3202.name: Kevin Durant
3202.short_comment: Durant will not play in Sunday's preseason rematch against Dallas, Varun Shankar of the Houston Chronicle reports. The forward finished Friday's preseason contest with 15 points (7-12 FG, 1-1 3Pt, 0-1 FT), two assists and one block in 23 minutes.

3904625.long_comment: This is a tough blow for Fall, as he's already facing an uphill battle to make the final roster. A return Oct. 16 isn't out of the question based on this timetable.
3904625.name: Tacko Fall
3904625.short_comment: Fall was diagnosed with a left hip strain Thursday and will miss at least two weeks, Kyle Neubeck of AllPHLY.com reports.

3907387.long_comment: Simmons is not yet ready to make his preseason debut. However, it seems he's in line to take the court for Sacramento's upcoming exhibition Saturday against the Warriors, per Marc J. Spears of ESPN.com. The Kings should have a better idea of his status for Saturday as tipoff nears.
3907387.name: Ben Simmons
3907387.short_comment: Simmons (not injury related) has been ruled out for Thursday's preseason game against the Lakers, Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

3907497.long_comment: Murray is dealing with a right toe contusion, though head coach Jamahl Mosley said his absence Thursday is precautionary. The veteran point guard's next chance to play in the preseason will come Wednesday against Dallas.
3907497.name: Dejounte Murray
3907497.short_comment: Murray (toe) has been ruled out for Thursday's preseason game against the Heat, Andrew Lopez of Gulf Coast Sports & Entertainment Network reports.

3913176.long_comment: The Clippers learned about the injury this summer, though it's unclear exactly how far along Ingram is in his recovery. The star forward's timeline for a return is unclear, clouding his fantasy outlook in the meantime. Darius Garland should take on all the usage he can handle in Ingram's stead, while Kris Dunn and Max Strus could have additional streaming appeal early in the year.
3913176.name: Brandon Ingram
3913176.short_comment: Ingram won't be ready for the start of the season due to a partially torn Achilles, per Joey Linn of SI.com.

3914285.long_comment: The Knicks plan to hold Eubanks out Thursday. His next chance to play would be Monday against Minnesota.
3914285.name: Drew Eubanks
3914285.short_comment: Eubanks (rest) is not in line to play in Thursday's preseason game against Wizards, Stefan Bondy of The New York Post reports.

3934673.long_comment: DiVincenzo is approaching six months since tearing his right Achilles during the first round of the playoffs and has been rehabbing with the expectation that he'll play at some point this season. The veteran guard has sought advice from Jayson Tatum, Tyrese Haliburton and Damian Lillard during his recovery, though Minnesota has yet to establish a timetable for his return.
3934673.name: Donte DiVincenzo
3934673.short_comment: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

3950760.long_comment: Kelley made 31 appearances with the G League's South Bay Lakers a season ago, averaging 8.0 points, 7.1 rebounds, 1.5 assists and 2.1 blocks in 25.5 minutes per game. He's earned himself an opportunity with the Heat following Thursday's signing, though he'll presumably end up being waived and head to the G League once again before the start of the 2026-27 campaign.
3950760.name: Kylor Kelley
3950760.short_comment: Kelley (calf) signed a contract with the Heat on Thursday, Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

3975.long_comment: Curry made the most of his limited court time, drilling three shots beyond the arc in short order. Curry won't travel with the team to Portland, and the veteran's preseason participation is expected to be very limited to avoid injury and keep him fresh for the regular season.
3975.name: Stephen Curry
3975.short_comment: Curry generated 16 points, 4-7 FG, 3-6 3Pt, 5-6 FT), five assists and two rebounds across 14 minutes in Tuesday's 124-98 preseason win over the Lakers.

3992.long_comment: Harden is dealing with right ankle soreness and will be held out of Cleveland's preseason opener. With the veteran guard sidelined, Jaylon Tyson will join Donovan Mitchell, Peyton Watson, Evan Mobley and Jarrett Allen in the starting five.
3992.name: James Harden
3992.short_comment: Harden (ankle) has been ruled out for Thursday's preseason game against the Celtics, Serena Winters of FanDuel Sports Network Ohio reports.

4065648.long_comment: Boston looks to be resting their starters for this exhibition. Hugo Gonzalez is starting at small forward Thursday.
4065648.name: Jayson Tatum
4065648.short_comment: Tatum (rest) isn't in line to play Thursday against Cleveland, Zack Cox of the Boston Herald reports.

4065654.long_comment: Isaac also wasn't spotted on the court during the media-viewing portions of Orlando's practices Monday or Tuesday. The veteran forward entered training camp limited while completing his recovery from the left knee sprain that ended his 2025-26 campaign, but his absence Wednesday is being attributed to personal reasons.
4065654.name: Jonathan Isaac
4065654.short_comment: Isaac (knee) won't travel with the Magic for Wednesday's preseason opener against the Grizzlies due to personal reasons, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

4065673.long_comment: The Knicks plan to keep Bradley out Thursday. His next chance to play would be Monday against Minnesota.
4065673.name: Tony Bradley
4065673.short_comment: Bradley (rest) is not in line to play in Thursday's preseason game against Wizards, Stefan Bondy of The New York Post reports.

4065778.long_comment: Plantar fascia injuries can be tricky to recover from, with the only remedy typically being prolonged rest, so don't be surprised if Strus' absence extends well beyond this initial four-week window. With Strus now set to miss at least the first few weeks of the season, and Bradley Beal (knee) uncertain for opening night, Keaton Wagler could be thrust into the first unit sooner than expected.
4065778.name: Max Strus
4065778.short_comment: Strus has been diagnosed with a partially torn plantar fascia in his right foot and he will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

4065804.long_comment: The Celtics are resting several players ahead of this preseason game, and that includes Hauser, who's expected to have a sizable role in the rotation this season. His next chance to play will come against the 76ers on Saturday.
4065804.name: Sam Hauser
4065804.short_comment: Hauser (rest) is out for Thursday's preseason game against the Cavaliers, Sean Grande of NBC Sports Boston reports.

4066218.long_comment: Williams will be re-evaluated the first week of the regular season, putting his status for Opening Night in the air. Williams will have a difficult path to minutes this season as he competes with the likes of Naz Reid, Royce O'Neale and Tidjane Salaun.
4066218.name: Grant Williams
4066218.short_comment: Williams will miss the preseason after suffering a right hamstring injury, the Hornets announced Friday.

4066259.long_comment: It's unclear exactly what is bothering Fox, though he was a late scratch due to soreness. His next chance to play in the preseason will come Saturday against the Suns.
4066259.name: De'Aaron Fox
4066259.short_comment: Fox won't play in Thursday's preseason game against the Hawks due to soreness, Jeff McDonald of the San Antonio Express-News reports.

4066262.long_comment: Monk didn't play in Monday's game against the Lakers, and he won't suit up for the rematch as well. His next chance to feature will come against the Warriors on Saturday.
4066262.name: Malik Monk
4066262.short_comment: Monk (rest) is out for Thursday's preseason game against the Lakers, Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

4066336.long_comment: Markkanen is sitting out an exhibition game with some minor neck soreness, but he should be able to get back out there for Monday's preseason game against the Spurs. Ace Bailey will have a chance to start sans Markkanen, and there will be more minutes available for Svi Mykhailiuk.
4066336.name: Lauri Markkanen
4066336.short_comment: Markkanen won't play in Tuesday's preseason game against the Nuggets due to neck soreness.

4066354.long_comment: This appears to be a scheduled rest day for Pritchard, as the Celtics are sitting a number of their regular rotation players. He'll have an opportunity to suit up for Saturday's exhibition against the 76ers.
4066354.name: Payton Pritchard
4066354.short_comment: Pritchard (undisclosed) has been ruled out for Thursday's preseason game against the Cavaliers, Sean Grande of NBC Sports Boston reports.

4066383.long_comment: Bridges exited Wednesday's preseason loss to the Bulls with a right ankle injury and did not return, though this news bodes well for his status ahead of the regular season. Ott added that the team will "be smart" with Bridges moving forward, so it wouldn't be surprising if he missed time during the preseason. The 28-year-old forward can be considered questionable for Saturday's exhibition against San Antonio until the Suns provide an update.
4066383.name: Miles Bridges
4066383.short_comment: Head coach Jordan Ott said Friday that Bridges' X-rays came back negative, and he participated in Friday's practice, Duane Rankin of The Arizona Republic reports.

4066436.long_comment: Melton is among several rotation players Golden State is holding out for the second half of a preseason back-to-back. The veteran guard has been working with the Warriors' second unit during training camp and should have another opportunity to suit up Saturday against Sacramento.
4066436.name: De'Anthony Melton
4066436.short_comment: Melton (rest) won't travel with the Warriors for Wednesday's preseason game against the Trail Blazers, Dalton Johnson of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.

4066650.long_comment: Collins is sitting out this exhibition but is nearing a return to the floor. The big man's next opportunity to suit up comes Sunday in Denver.
4066650.name: Zach Collins
4066650.short_comment: Collins (toe) won't play in Friday's preseason game against the Grizzlies, K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network reports.

4066993.long_comment: This is a tough blow for the point guard who was penciled in as the top backup behind Davion Mitchell. If he indeed misses a couple weeks, he could be back in time for their final preseason contest Oct. 16.
4066993.name: Dru Smith
4066993.short_comment: Smith will miss a couple weeks with a strained right calf, Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

4222252.long_comment: Hartenstein is sitting out once again with ankle soreness after missing the Thunder's preseason opener. His next chance for exhibition action is Monday against the Hawks.
4222252.name: Isaiah Hartenstein
4222252.short_comment: Hartenstein (ankle) won't play in Wednesday's preseason game against the Bucks, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

4251.long_comment: The Celtics are holding several key contributors out of the starting lineup Thursday. Jordan Walsh is drawing the start at power forward.
4251.name: Paul George
4251.short_comment: George (rest) isn't in line to play Thursday versus Cleveland, Zack Cox of the Boston Herald reports.

4277811.long_comment: Sexton has been battling a lower-body injury and will miss his third matchup of the preseason. However, the team isn't overly concerned at this point for what coach JJ Redick is deeming a minor injury for the 27-year-old guard, per Daniel Starkand of LakersNation.com.
4277811.name: Collin Sexton
4277811.short_comment: Sexton (lower body) has been ruled out for Thursday's preseason game against Sacramento, Benjamin Royer of The Orange County Register reports.

4277880.long_comment: Williams won't be an option for this contest, but the big man isn't likely to play a big role with the Spurs anytime soon. He's expected to play for the Austin Spurs in the G League in the 2026-27 campaign. His next chance to play in the preseason will come against the Suns on Saturday.
4277880.name: Malik Williams
4277880.short_comment: Williams (undisclosed) is out for Thursday's preseason game against the Hawks, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

4278067.long_comment: This is a huge blow for Claxton and it rules him out for the entire preseason. For now, fantasy managers can consider him questionable for Opening Night on Oct. 21 against the Raptors. Jalen Smith is the next man up on the depth chart for Chicago, followed by Zach Collins (toe).
4278067.name: Nic Claxton
4278067.short_comment: Claxton tweaked his hamstring and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Chuck Swirsky of the Bulls Radio Network of the Bulls Radio Network reports.

4278073.long_comment: Gilgeous-Alexander delivered a flawless offensive performance in limited action, converting every field-goal and free-throw attempt while helping Oklahoma City establish a commanding first-half advantage. The Thunder rested their starters after halftime, and Milwaukee capitalized against Oklahoma City's reserves. His efficiency and playmaking were encouraging signs, although preseason shooting percentages carry limited predictive value given the restricted minutes and experimental rotations.  If this game offered any sign ahead of the regular season, it's that Gilgeous-Alexander should be read
4278073.name: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
4278073.short_comment: Gilgeous-Alexander produced 17 points (5-5 FG, 3-3 3Pt, 4-4 FT), three rebounds, five assists and a block across 18 minutes in Wednesday's 128-126 preseason loss to the Bucks.

4278078.long_comment: The severity of Washington's ankle injury is unclear, but his next chance to suit up will come during Sunday's rematch against the Rockets in China. The veteran forward is expected to have a key role for the Mavs heading into the 2026-27 season, though coach Dusty May isn't ready to commit to the Kentucky product as a mainstay in the starting five. It's worth noting that Washington has come off the bench only four times in 113 regular-season appearances for Dallas over the last two years.
4278078.name: P.J. Washington
4278078.short_comment: Washington won't play in Friday's preseason game against the Rockets.

4278104.long_comment: Porter's absence comes after he scored 16 points in Tuesday's preseason win over Charlotte. The Nets haven't indicated whether the wrist issue will affect his availability beyond Thursday, though his next opportunity to play will come in Brooklyn's next exhibition contest.
4278104.name: Michael Porter Jr.
4278104.short_comment: Porter will not play in Thursday's preseason game against Philadelphia due to left wrist soreness, Brian Lewis of the New York Post reports.

4351851.long_comment: Simons also missed Monday's preseason opener against the Knicks due to the injury. His next opportunity to make his preseason debut will come Oct. 16 against Boston.
4351851.name: Anfernee Simons
4351851.short_comment: Simons (right hamstring) isn't expected to play in either of Philadelphia's next two preseason games against Brooklyn and Boston, Dave McMenamin of ESPN reports.

4351852.long_comment: Robinson will join several other rotation players on the sidelines for Boston's preseason opener. The big man's next chance to play in the preseason will come Saturday against the 76ers.
4351852.name: Mitchell Robinson
4351852.short_comment: Robinson (undisclosed) won't play in Thursday's preseason game against the Cavaliers, Sean Grande of NBC Sports Boston reports.

4395626.long_comment: Jones is still considered day-to-day due to a left hip injury, with his next chance to play coming in Sunday's exhibition against Denver. In the meantime, Dailyn Swain and Jordan Hawkins could see increased playing time.
4395626.name: Tre Jones
4395626.short_comment: Jones (hip) has been ruled out for Friday's preseason game against the Grizzlies, K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network reports.

4395650.long_comment: Black took a shot to the face and appeared to have been poked in the eye. He can be considered questionable for Saturday's exhibition against Golden State until the Kings offer an update on his status.
4395650.name: Leaky Black
4395650.short_comment: Black (face) exited to the locker room in the fourth quarter of Thursday's 114-110 preseason loss to the Lakers and did not return, finishing with four points (2-2 FG), two rebounds, one assist and one steal across 11 minutes.

4395651.long_comment: White missed time with a left calf strain last season and is now in jeopardy of starting the regular season on the inactive list. If the 26-year-old guard is forced to miss time beyond the preseason, Christian Anderson and Dennis Schroder would likely see increased playing time.
4395651.name: Coby White
4395651.short_comment: The Hornets announced Monday that White suffered a left calf strain during training camp and will not play during the preseason.

4396818.long_comment: It's a tough break for Miller, who had an opportunity to battle for a reserve role during training camp in the fall. The timeline for a return is likely to keep him on the shelf until after the All-Star break. Miller's extended stay on the sidelines gives Kobe Sanders a chance to crack the Clippers' rotation.
4396818.name: Jordan Miller
4396818.short_comment: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

4397018.long_comment: The Knicks are holding out some of their players on non-guaranteed deals Thursday. According to Bondy, Agbaji will play in Monday's preseason game against the Timberwolves.
4397018.name: Ochai Agbaji
4397018.short_comment: Agbaji (coach's decision) won't play in Thursday's preseason game against Washington, Stefan Bondy of The New York Post reports.

4397020.long_comment: Dort will remain on the shelf for a second straight preseason game due to a right knee contusion. His next opportunity to suit up in the preseason will come against the Pacers on Saturday.
4397020.name: Luguentz Dort
4397020.short_comment: Dort (knee) has been ruled out for Thursday's preseason matchup with San Antonio, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

4397189.long_comment: Smith is dealing with left foot soreness, and his next chance to suit up will come in Sunday's exhibition against Denver. With Nic Claxton (hamstring) and Zach Collins (toe) also out, Tobe Awaka and Leonard Miller figure to see increased burn Friday.
4397189.name: Jalen Smith
4397189.short_comment: Smith (foot) has been ruled out for Friday's preseason game against the Grizzlies, K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network reports.

4397251.long_comment: It's unclear why Harper won't suit up for Boston's preseason opener. His next opportunity to play will come in Saturday's preseason game against Philadelphia.
4397251.name: Ron Harper Jr.
4397251.short_comment: Harper (undisclosed) won't play in Thursday's preseason game against the Cavaliers, Sean Grande of NBC Sports Boston reports.

4397424.long_comment: Boston seems to be holding out their expected starters for this exhibition. Luka Garza is getting a chance to start at center for the Celtics on Thursday.
4397424.name: Neemias Queta
4397424.short_comment: Queta (rest) isn't in line to play Thursday against Cleveland, Zack Cox of the Boston Herald reports.

4411057.long_comment: While it's unclear exactly why McCullar isn't suiting up, it doesn't appear to be an injury-related decision. The two-way player is once again expected to spend most of his time with the G League's Westchester Knicks in 2026-27.
4411057.name: Kevin McCullar Jr.
4411057.short_comment: McCullar (undisclosed) won't play in Thursday's preseason game against the Wizards but is in line to suit up for Monday's preseason matchup with Minnesota, Stefan Bondy of The New York Post reports.

4431684.long_comment: Jackson-Davis also missed Saturday's preseason opener against Miami, and it's unclear what's keeping him sidelined. His status will be worth monitoring ahead of Saturday's preseason matchup with the Clippers.
4431684.name: Trayce Jackson-Davis
4431684.short_comment: Correcting a previous report, Jackson-Davis (migraines) was absent from Tuesday's practice, Josh Lewenberg of TSN.ca reports.

4431786.long_comment: Johnson doesn't sound to be a candidate for preseason reps, but it's encouraging to hear he's progressing in his hamstring recovery. A two-way player, Johnson will likely be shuttled to the G League's Sioux Falls Skyforce once healthy later this fall.
4431786.name: Keshad Johnson
4431786.short_comment: Johnson (hamstring) is practicing in a limited fashion, per Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel.

4431893.long_comment: The severity of the lower-back issue is unclear, though it kept Battle out of last Saturday's preseason-opening loss to the Heat. He'll look to continue making progress in practices ahead of Saturday's preseason matchup with the Clippers.
4431893.name: Jamison Battle
4431893.short_comment: Battle (lower back) was a limited participant in Monday's practice, Esfandiar Baraheni of The Athletic reports.

4432107.long_comment: Sasser is competing for a bench role ahead of the 2026-27 season, and he's showing early on why he deserves a spot in the rotation, though missing time won't help his cause. Sasser averaged 5.2 points, 1.0 rebounds and 2.0 assists in 38 regular-season appearances a season ago in Detroit before joining Dallas in June as part of a six-team trade.
4432107.name: Marcus Sasser
4432107.short_comment: Sasser won't play in Friday's preseason game against the Rockets due to left adductor soreness.

4432165.long_comment: Suggs has been sick for nearly a week, and while it may not affect his regular-season availability, it has limited his training camp reps. The veteran point guard was sidelined for Orlando's preseason opener last Wednesday, and his status for Sunday's exhibition in Cleveland remains unclear.
4432165.name: Jalen Suggs
4432165.short_comment: Magic head coach Sean Sweeney said Suggs (illness) increased his activity level at Saturday's practice and looked more like himself, but they can't "skip steps" in the point guard's recovery, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

4432171.long_comment: Moody suffered the injury March 23 and underwent season-ending surgery four days later. The 24-year-old had been targeting September to resume running and on-court work, so his latest progress appears to keep his rehabilitation on track, though he remains without a firm timetable for his return to game action.
4432171.name: Moses Moody
4432171.short_comment: Moody has progressed to light on-court activities as he continues his recovery from a ruptured left patellar tendon, Evan Webeck of The Mercury News reports.

4432185.long_comment: Peavy missed a third consecutive contest due to an ankle injury. His final chance to play in the preseason will come next Friday against Charlotte.
4432185.name: Micah Peavy
4432185.short_comment: Peavy (ankle) did not see the floor in Friday's 104-100 preseason win over the Bulls.

4432194.long_comment: The severity of Sharpe's shoulder issue remains unclear, though the team is likely being cautious for this exhibition. His absence could create additional frontcourt opportunities for Brooklyn's other big men during Thursday's contest.
4432194.name: Day'Ron Sharpe
4432194.short_comment: Sharpe has been ruled out for Thursday's preseason matchup against Philadelphia due to left shoulder soreness, Brian Lewis of the New York Post reports.

4432586.long_comment: Bittle is dealing with a foot injury. He's been wearing a walking boot, so it's unknown if he will be cleared for action against the Clippers on Oct. 10.
4432586.name: Nate Bittle
4432586.short_comment: Bittle (foot) did not play in Saturday's 129-105 preseason loss to the Heat.

4432810.long_comment: Stewart, who was traded from Detroit to Memphis over the summer, sustained a left ankle sprain in the team's preseason opener and is now likely to miss Opening Night. His absence opens the door for Quinten Post to move into the backup center role behind Zach Edey in the interim.
4432810.name: Isaiah Stewart
4432810.short_comment: The Grizzlies announced Friday that Stewart (ankle) will miss at least two weeks.

4432823.long_comment: Williams is one of several regular rotation players who won't be suiting up Wednesday. His absence will give rookie Aday Mara more minutes, and the Spaniard turned heads in Tuesday's game against the Lakers. Williams' next chance to play in the preseason will come against the Hawks on Monday, Oct. 12.
4432823.name: Jaylin Williams
4432823.short_comment: Williams (heel) is out for Wednesday's preseason game against the Bucks, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

4433136.long_comment: Kessler will miss a third consecutive contest due to a finger injury, though head coach JJ Redick isn't concerned that it's a long-term issue, per Daniel Starkand of LakersNation.com. The big man's next opportunity to play in the preseason will come Tuesday against the Warriors.
4433136.name: Walker Kessler
4433136.short_comment: Kessler (finger) won't play in Thursday's preseason game against the Kings, Benjamin Royer of The Orange County Register reports.

4433137.long_comment: Williams was also held out for the second half of a preseason back-to-back Tuesday, and he'll take a seat again Thursday with coach JJ Redick indicating a number of Lakers are dealing with minor injuries, per Daniel Starkand of LakersNation.com. Williams' next opportunity to return will arrive Tuesday against Golden State.
4433137.name: Ziaire Williams
4433137.short_comment: Williams (undisclosed) won't play in Thursday's preseason game against the Kings, Benjamin Royer of The Orange County Register reports.

4433255.long_comment: It's unknown how severe the quad contusion is, though Holmgren is likely being held out for precautionary reasons. With Isaiah Hartenstein (ankle) and Jaylin Williams (heel) also sidelined against the Bucks, Aday Mara may make another start.
4433255.name: Chet Holmgren
4433255.short_comment: Holmgren (quadriceps) won't play in Wednesday's preseason game against Milwaukee, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

4433287.long_comment: Miller suffered a shin contusion during Tuesday's practice. Although there haven't been further details, his absence against the Nets is likely precautionary. The 23-year-old ended the 2025-26 campaign by averaging 20.2 points, 4.9 rebounds, 3.3 assists and 1.0 steals while shooting a career-high 38.3 percent from deep over 30.3 minutes per contest in 65 regular-season games.
4433287.name: Brandon Miller
4433287.short_comment: Miller (leg) is listed as out for Tuesday's preseason game versus the Nets.

4433599.long_comment: Kaluma is set to miss a third straight preseason game, and while head coach JJ Redick said he's not worried about any long-term injury, it's concerning that Kaluma hasn't logged a single minute in the preseason. His next chance to suit up will come against the Warriors on Tuesday.
4433599.name: Arthur Kaluma
4433599.short_comment: Kaluma (lower body) is out for Thursday's preseason game against the Kings, Benjamin Royer of The Orange County Register reports.

4433621.long_comment: After Duren engaged in a long standoff regarding contract negotiations with Detroit, the Pistons are monitoring the big man's reps as he ramps up his activity at training camp. His next chance to see exhibition action comes Saturday in Washington.
4433621.name: Jalen Duren
4433621.short_comment: Duren (rest) is expected to play at some point this preseason, per Hunter Patterson of The Athletic.

4585618.long_comment: Gilbert appeared in Atlanta's first preseason matchup Monday against Memphis, but he was unable to go Thursday. He can be considered day-to-day moving forward.
4585618.name: Keshon Gilbert
4585618.short_comment: Gilbert didn't play in Thursday's 123-116 preseason win over the Spurs due to left patella tendinitis, Lauren L. Williams of The Atlanta Journal-Constitution reports.

4592427.long_comment: It's unclear how much of Thursday's practice Jones took part in, though it's encouraging to see him doing on-court work. The 25-year-old forward tweaked his hamstring early in training camp and has missed each of the team's first two preseason games. Although Jones is considered day-to-day, the Nuggets may continue exercising caution ahead of their regular-season opener against the Thunder on Thursday, Oct. 22.
4592427.name: Spencer Jones
4592427.short_comment: Jones (hamstring) participated in on-court work after Thursday's practice, Katy Winge of Altitude Sports reports.

4593125.long_comment: Aldama underwent knee surgery in March and has been limited during training camp practices. It's unclear when he'll be cleared to make his Mavericks debut. The 2021 No. 30 overall pick had spent his entire career in Memphis before being traded to Dallas in July 2026. In 278 regular-season games, including 82 starts, he has averaged 10.4 points, 5.4 rebounds and 2.1 assists over 23.4 minutes per contest.
4593125.name: Santi Aldama
4593125.short_comment: Aldama (knee) won't play in Friday's preseason game against the Rockets.

4593803.long_comment: Williams was highly effective inside the arc, making eight of his 11 field-goal attempts while contributing six assists and two steals, but he missed all three of his three-point attempts. Long-range shooting woes aside, the star forward helped Oklahoma City build an 82-64 halftime lead before sitting out the second half alongside most of the Thunder's starters. Williams was limited to just 33 regular-season appearances in 2025-26, but if he stays healthy in 2026-27, he should operate as the team's No. 2 option on offense behind Shai Gilgeous-Alexander.
4593803.name: Jalen Williams
4593803.short_comment: Williams tallied 16 points (8-11 FG, 0-3 3Pt), three rebounds, six assists and two steals across 19 minutes in Wednesday's 128-126 preseason loss to the Bucks.

4594327.long_comment: Murray appears to be dealing with some kind of injury, though the team has yet to provide any additional details. He can continue to be considered day-to-day leading up to Saturday's exhibition against the Warriors.
4594327.name: Keegan Murray
4594327.short_comment: Murray (undisclosed) won't play in Thursday's preseason game against the Lakers, Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

4601025.long_comment: Larsson was previously expected to play after missing Wednesday's practice with an illness, though he's since been ruled out. His next opportunity to suit up in the preseason will come Saturday against Minnesota.
4601025.name: Pelle Larsson
4601025.short_comment: Larsson (illness) won't play in Thursday's preseason game against the Pelicans, Anthony Chiang of the Miami Herald reports.

4606840.long_comment: Watkins, a two-way player for the Wizards, suffered the injury during the Summer League. Although Washington has yet to offer a timetable for a return, a typical recovery time for the procedure is approximately 9-to-12 months. That leaves Watkins in serious jeopardy of missing most, if not all, of the 2026-27 season, and it remains to be seen if the team will continue keeping him around on a two-way roster spot while he's injured.
4606840.name: Jamir Watkins
4606840.short_comment: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.

4683688.long_comment: Mavericks president Masai Ujiri said that Lively has progressed to shooting and is working toward running on the court, though Dallas intends to remain patient with the 22-year-old. Lively underwent right foot surgery in December after appearing in just seven regular-season games in 2025-26, averaging 4.3 points, 5.3 rebounds, 1.9 assists and 1.6 blocks in 16.4 minutes per game. He has yet to be cleared for training camp, and his status for the regular season remains uncertain.
4683688.name: Dereck Lively II
4683688.short_comment: Lively (foot) won't play in Friday's preseason game against the Rockets.

4683692.long_comment: Wallace appears set to play after missing the preseason opener. The swingman is vying for a larger role on the wing after the Thunder lost Luguentz Dort over the summer.
4683692.name: Cason Wallace
4683692.short_comment: Wallace (rest) is in line to play in Wednesday's preseason game against the Bucks, Justin Martinez of The Oklahoman reports.

4684269.long_comment: It doesn't sound like the two-way guard will be available for the preseason, but he's hopeful to not miss any time during the G League season. Boswell is not expected to be a significant part of the Hornets' rotation this season.
4684269.name: Kylan Boswell
4684269.short_comment: Boswell is rehabbing a right knee injury, and he's hopeful to be cleared for basketball activities prior to the start of the G League season in late October.

4684793.long_comment: Filipowski has yet to play or practice since the preseason began on Oct. 4. His next chance to suit up will come next Monday against the Spurs.
4684793.name: Kyle Filipowski
4684793.short_comment: Filipowski (back) is out for Tuesday's exhibition versus the Nuggets.

4701230.long_comment: Johnson will sit out Atlanta's second preseason game after posting eight points (1-7 FG, 0-3 3Pt, 6-6 FT), five rebounds, three assists and one steal in 18 minutes during Monday's loss to Memphis. His next chance to play in the preseason will come against Indiana on Saturday.
4701230.name: Jalen Johnson
4701230.short_comment: Johnson (rest) has been ruled out for Thursday's preseason game against San Antonio, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

4701232.long_comment: This is a tough blow for the center with training camp right around the corner. With his status for Opening Night in jeopardy, this will put a lot of eyes on Oso Ighodaro and Khaman Maluach, with the latter already drawing buzz during the Summer League. More clarity on Williams' timeline should be known in the coming weeks.
4701232.name: Mark Williams
4701232.short_comment: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

4702352.long_comment: With Sanders having already missed the Clippers' preseason opener due to a left hip impingement, his continued limitations in practice suggest he still isn't back to full activity. The day-to-day designation keeps him in play to suit up at some point this preseason, but his availability for upcoming exhibition action remains uncertain until he resumes five-on-five work.
4702352.name: Kobe Sanders
4702352.short_comment: Sanders (hip) was limited to individual player development work and did not take part in five-on-five activity Wednesday, Tomer Azarly of ClutchPoints.com reports. Azarly adds that the Clippers said Sanders is day-to-day.

4709138.long_comment: The deal is a fully guaranteed, rookie-scale contract extension that includes a mutual option for the 2031-32 season. Podziemski is coming off a 2025-26 campaign in which he averaged career highs in points (13.8) and three-pointers (1.9) while starting in 43 of 82 regular-season games. Podziemski figures to start alongside Stephen Curry (rest) in the backcourt to open the 2026-27 season, though that could change once Jimmy Butler (knee) is cleared to return.
4709138.name: Brandin Podziemski
4709138.short_comment: Podziemski (rest) and the Warriors agreed to a five-year, $110 million contract extension Saturday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

4711294.long_comment: Buzelis appeared to twist his ankle earlier in the game but initially played through the injury. His status will be worth monitoring ahead of Sunday's exhibition against Denver. With the 2024 first-rounder out for the remainder of the game, Dailyn Swain and Leonard Miller could see increased playing time.
4711294.name: Matas Buzelis
4711294.short_comment: Buzelis exited to the locker room in the second quarter and will not return to Friday's preseason game against the Grizzlies due to a right ankle injury, K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network reports. He'll finish with six points (3-6 FG, 0-2 3Pt) and one block in 12 minutes.

4712849.long_comment: Black sounds to be making good progress in his recovery from a right ankle sprain. The fourth-year guard has a chance to make his preseason debut Sunday against Cleveland as he prepares to occupy the sixth man role for Orlando this season.
4712849.name: Anthony Black
4712849.short_comment: Black (ankle) was a full participant in Friday's practice, per Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel.

4712863.long_comment: Gueye will be re-evaluated by medical staff in 3-to-4 months, which means he'll miss all of training camp and preseason and likely the start of the 2026-27 regular season. It's a brutal blow for the fourth-year big man, given that the Hawks used the No. 23 overall pick of the 2026 NBA Draft to select St. John's product Zuby Ejiofor. Gueye's absence means Ejiofor will have more opportunities in the preseason, and the rookie could establish a key role off the bench behind Onyeka Okongwu and projected backup center Jock Landale (ankle).
4712863.name: Mouhamed Gueye
4712863.short_comment: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

4870562.long_comment: Barlow also missed Monday's preseason opener against New York due to the back issue. His next opportunity to make his preseason debut will come Oct. 16 against Boston.
4870562.name: Dominick Barlow
4870562.short_comment: Barlow (back) isn't expected to play in either of Philadelphia's next two preseason games against Brooklyn and Boston, Dave McMenamin of ESPN.com reports.

4870564.long_comment: Jefferson will miss his second consecutive preseason contest after sitting out Tuesday's win over Charlotte. The rookie forward's return timeline remains unclear, and the missed time could limit his opportunities to compete for a rotation role ahead of the regular season.
4870564.name: Joshua Jefferson
4870564.short_comment: Jefferson (back) will not play in Thursday's preseason game against the 76ers, Brian Lewis of the New York Post reports.

4871141.long_comment: Hukporti went down with an Achilles injury in Monday's preseason opener against the Knicks, and an MRI has since revealed a rupture. He signed a one-year deal with the 76ers over the summer, so Hukporti will be an unrestricted free agent come season's end. With Hukporti's year already finished, Adem Bona (foot) should assume the backup center role behind Joel Embiid once healthy.
4871141.name: Ariel Hukporti
4871141.short_comment: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

4897943.long_comment: Knecht is dealing with an undisclosed contusion. His next opportunity to take the floor will come in Tuesday's preseason meeting with the Warriors.
4897943.name: Dalton Knecht
4897943.short_comment: Knecht won't play in Thursday's preseason game against the Kings due to a contusion, Mike Trudell of Spectrum SportsNet reports.

4898010.long_comment: Sellers continues to nurse lower-back soreness. His next chance to play comes Sunday in Denver.
4898010.name: Jaylin Sellers
4898010.short_comment: Sellers (back) won't play in Friday's preseason game against the Grizzlies, K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network reports.

4900671.long_comment: Mitchell started in Tuesday's 116-110 loss to the Pelicans. However, with Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Cason Wallace and Alex Caruso starting Wednesday, Mitchell will head to the bench.
4900671.name: Ajay Mitchell
4900671.short_comment: Mitchell is not in the starting lineup for Wednesday's preseason game against Milwaukee, Brandon Rahbar of DailyThunder.com reports.

4914336.long_comment: It's a tough blow to the Trail Blazers' depth on the wing ahead of training camp. Sharpe, who is now likely to be sidelined until after the All-Star break, had been ticketed for a reserve role behind Toumani Camara following an injury-plagued 2025-26 campaign, which saw average a career-high 20.8 points, 1.4 steals and 2.1 three-pointers per game over 50 regular-season appearances. The door is now open for Vit Krejci and Jeremy Sochan to compete for bench minutes during camp.
4914336.name: Shaedon Sharpe
4914336.short_comment: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

4997530.long_comment: Diop will sit out the Cavaliers' preseason opener for undisclosed reasons. His next chance to play in the preseason will come Sunday against the Magic.
4997530.name: Khalifa Diop
4997530.short_comment: Diop (undisclosed) won't play in Thursday's preseason game against Boston, Serena Winters of FanDuel Sports Network Ohio reports.

4997536.long_comment: Santos started Tuesday's 124-98 preseason win over the Lakers and remains in the mix for a significant role after starting 30 games during the 2025-26 regular season. Golden State is holding several rotation players out for the second half of a preseason back-to-back, and Santos should have another opportunity to suit up Saturday against Sacramento.
4997536.name: Gui Santos
4997536.short_comment: Santos (rest) won't travel with the Warriors for Wednesday's preseason game against the Trail Blazers, Dalton Johnson of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.

4997537.long_comment: Although the big man will remain a limited participant in training camp as he continues his rehab from a hip impingement, it sounds like his absence from game action will extend into the regular season. Deandre Ayton should have the backup center role all to himself until Vukcevic is cleared to retake the floor.
4997537.name: Tristan Vukcevic
4997537.short_comment: The Wizards announced Thursday that Vukcevic (hip) will be re-evaluated in four weeks.

5060701.long_comment: The Hornets are taking a cautious approach with the rookie first-rounder, who suffered an ankle sprain in practice. His next chance to play comes Sunday against the Bucks.
5060701.name: Christian Anderson
5060701.short_comment: Anderson (ankle) won't play in Tuesday's preseason game against the Nets.

5061575.long_comment: Knueppel's status for Opening Night remains uncertain as he continues to work his way back from his left hamstring injury. Peterson's comments suggest the Hornets aren't ready to rule out the second-year wing, though his availability will likely become clearer as training camp progresses. He has already been ruled out for the entire preseason, to be clear.
5061575.name: Kon Knueppel
5061575.short_comment: Hornets general manager Jeff Peterson said Monday that he "doesn't know" whether Knueppel (hamstring) will be available for the team's regular-season opener against the Nets, Owen Watterson of SI.com reports.

5061603.long_comment: Sorber remains a limited participant in training camp following September 2025 knee surgery. His next chance to make his preseason debut is Monday against the Hawks.
5061603.name: Thomas Sorber
5061603.short_comment: Sorber (knee) won't play in Wednesday's preseason game against the Bucks, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

5101761.long_comment: Brown also missed Tuesday's preseason opener against Charlotte and has been working his way back into basketball activities after suffering the injury during training camp. Brooklyn has been cautious with the rookie guard's recovery, and he remains without a firm timetable for his preseason debut.
5101761.name: Mikel Brown Jr.
5101761.short_comment: Brown (ankle) will miss Thursday's preseason game against Philadelphia, Brian Lewis of the New York Post reports.

5101845.long_comment: The Spurs are expected to exercise extreme caution with the big man, as Quaintance suffered a torn ACL and meniscus with Arizona State in February 2025 before appearing in only four games with Kentucky last season due to severe complications and persistent swelling. The 19-year-old underwent a cleanup procedure on his meniscus in mid-July, and the Spurs will likely want him at 100 percent before ramping him up to basketball activities.
5101845.name: Jayden Quaintance
5101845.short_comment: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

5105337.long_comment: Brown is dealing with some tightness, so this sounds like a precaution. The No. 44 overall pick in the 2026 NBA Draft is not expected to crack the rotation on Opening Night.
5105337.name: Maliq Brown
5105337.short_comment: Brown (back) is out for Thursday's preseason game against the Hawks, Tom Orsborn of the San Antonio Express-News reports.

5105571.long_comment: Veesaar suffered the injury during a workout on Sept. 15, and an MRI confirmed the diagnosis. The No. 52 overall pick in the 2026 NBA Draft, Veesaar was expected to spend a lot of time with Atlanta's G League affiliate this season.
5105571.name: Henri Veesaar
5105571.short_comment: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

5105637.long_comment: Bona has yet to practice during training camp while recovering from the foot injury he suffered during FIBA competition. With Ariel Hukporti (Achilles) out indefinitely, Philadelphia will be particularly thin at center until Bona is cleared to return.
5105637.name: Adem Bona
5105637.short_comment: Bona (left foot) isn't expected to play in either of Philadelphia's next two preseason games against Brooklyn and Boston, Dave McMenamin of ESPN.com reports.

5105839.long_comment: A left hip injury will keep Sensabaugh off the floor for the rematch with Denver. The Jazz will likely be cautious with the 22-year-old, so it's reasonable to believe he could also miss Monday's exhibition versus the Spurs.
5105839.name: Brice Sensabaugh
5105839.short_comment: Sensabaugh (hip) won't play in Tuesday's preseason game against the Nuggets.

5106268.long_comment: Tomlin is dealing with lower-back soreness and will be held out of Cleveland's preseason opener. His next chance to suit up in the preseason will come Sunday against Orlando.
5106268.name: Nae'Qwan Tomlin
5106268.short_comment: Tomlin (back) won't play in Thursday's preseason game against Boston, Serena Winters of FanDuel Sports Network Ohio reports.

5107251.long_comment: With Nelson still in recovery mode from the left ankle surgery he underwent this summer, his path back to game action remains delayed for the early part of the season. The rookie big man is on a two-way contract with the Magic, so his short-term absence mainly affects his developmental timeline rather than Orlando's regular rotation.
5107251.name: Izaiyah Nelson
5107251.short_comment: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.

5108024.long_comment: Niederhauser is progressing from March surgery but won't be able to suit up to begin the year. The Clippers are likely to take a cautious approach with the 2025 first-rounder. Isaiah Jackson should occupy the backup center spot behind Brook Lopez early in the campaign.
5108024.name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
5108024.short_comment: Niederhauser (foot) won't be ready for the start of the season, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.

5113969.long_comment: Carr and several other players are reportedly dealing with minor injuries, per Daniel Starkand of LakersNation.com, but the Lakers aren't concerned about him missing any regular-season action. His next chance to play will arrive Tuesday against the Warriors.
5113969.name: Cameron Carr
5113969.short_comment: Carr (undisclosed) won't play in Thursday's preseason game against the Kings, Benjamin Royer of The Orange County Register reports.

5149115.long_comment: Graves tweaked his groin earlier in training camp and was held out of Saturday's preseason opener against Miami. The rookie remains day-to-day, with Toronto's next preseason game coming Saturday against the Clippers.
5149115.name: Allen Graves
5149115.short_comment: Graves (groin) was limited during Sunday's practice, Josh Lewenberg of TSN.ca reports.

5157066.long_comment: Furphy started in 21 of 35 regular-season appearances for the Pacers, posting averages of 5.1 points, 4.4 rebounds, 1.2 assists and 0.7 three-pointers in 18.4 minutes per contest. While no timetable has been announced, Furphy's absence could extend through the beginning of the 2026-27 season. With this news, the Pacers will likely lean more on Ben Sheppard, Kam Jones and Quenton Jackson moving forward.
5157066.name: Johnny Furphy
5157066.short_comment: Furphy was diagnosed with a torn right ACL on Monday and will miss the remainder of the season, Michael Scotto of USA Today reports.

5159925.long_comment: Topic is still ramping up after undergoing back surgery in mid-June, and he'll miss a second straight preseason game. His next chance to play in the preseason will come Monday against the Hawks.
5159925.name: Nikola Topic
5159925.short_comment: Topic (back) won't play in Wednesday's preseason game against the Bucks, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

5160992.long_comment: Keefe indicated that a decision on Sarr's availability will be made Saturday, suggesting the big man could be nearing a return to game action. Even if Sarr is cleared to play, Washington could manage his workload during the preseason.
5160992.name: Alex Sarr
5160992.short_comment: Wizards head coach Brian Keefe said Friday that Sarr (foot) is trending in a positive direction regarding his availability, though his status for Saturday's preseason game remains uncertain, Josh Robbins of The Athletic reports.

5164559.long_comment: Ament landed awkwardly on his left ankle and exited to the locker room near the end of the first half. His next opportunity to suit up in the preseason will come Sunday against the Hornets, though it wouldn't be surprising to see the Bucks exercise caution moving forward.
5164559.name: Nate Ament
5164559.short_comment: Ament won't return to Wednesday's preseason game against the Thunder due to a left ankle sprain. He'll finish with three points (1-7 FG, 0-1 3Pt, 1-4 FT), four rebounds, one assist and one steal in 10 minutes.

5175737.long_comment: The rookie is one of several Warriors not making the trip for maintenance reasons. He produced  17 points (7-11 FG, 2-3 3Pt, 1-2 FT), nine rebounds and two assists across 21 minutes in Tuesday's 124-98 preseason win over the Lakers and continues to impress the coaching staff.
5175737.name: Yaxel Lendeborg
5175737.short_comment: Lendeborg (rest) is out for Wednesday's preseason game against the Trail Blazers, Anthony Slater of ESPN.com reports.

5214637.long_comment: Penda has been working his way back from a hamstring injury, and while he was able to participate in Sunday's practice, he's not quite ready for game-time action. His next chance to play will come Sunday in Cleveland.
5214637.name: Noah Penda
5214637.short_comment: Penda (hamstring) is out for Wednesday's preseason game in Memphis, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

6430.long_comment: Butler is still months away from retaking the floor, according to Nick Friedell of The Athletic, so a season debut at some point December might be too optimistic. The star forward remains without a definitive timeline for a return after undergoing ACL surgery in early February, which typically carries at least a nine-month recovery period. Butler makes sense as an injury stash at the end of fantasy drafts, but managers should likely be bracing for him to miss at least the first two months of the regular season.
6430.name: Jimmy Butler III
6430.short_comment: The Warriors hope to have Butler (knee) back early in 2027, per Keith Watkins of Yahoo Sports.

6440.long_comment: "It's a calf strain, the seriousness is what it is," said Johnson. "We won't rush him at all. I guess the question will be is he ready for the season opener? Totally questionable and we will not push that at all. So, we'll take it slow. There is no concern of this level of seriousness, and at the same time, we will not rush him at all." It sounds like Harris, who has already been ruled out for the preseason, is in danger of missing opening night. His absence will open up minutes for Julian Champagnie, Keldon Johnson and Harrison Barnes.
6440.name: Tobias Harris
6440.short_comment: Spurs head coach Mitch Johnson said they will not rush Tobias Harris (calf) back to the court, Jared Weiss of The Athletic reports.

6450.long_comment: Leonard will miss a second straight preseason game while ramping up his workload following the offseason, but he's not dealing with an injury. His next chance to play in the preseason will come Tuesday against the Knicks.
6450.name: Kawhi Leonard
6450.short_comment: Leonard (not injury related) won't suit up for Saturday's exhibition against the Clippers, Tomer Azarly of ClutchPoints.com reports.

6580.long_comment: With Beal already set to miss the start of training camp, it sounds like the veteran guard still hasn't progressed to full-contact work. His continued knee inflammation keeps his ramp-up timeline uncertain and suggests the Clippers will continue to manage his workload in camp.
6580.name: Bradley Beal
6580.short_comment: Beal (knee) isn't participating in five-on-five work and is doing individual player development work, Tomer Azarly of ClutchPoints.com reports. Azarly adds that the Clippers said Wednesday that Beal is continuing to have inflammation managed.

6589.long_comment: The Warriors are being cautious with Green's workload in the preseason, so he'll be limited to around 20 minutes Tuesday and won't suit up Wednesday. This is part of a long-term picture, as the idea is to have Green as healthy as possible for the start of the regular season against the Lakers on Oct. 21.
6589.name: Draymond Green
6589.short_comment: Green will be limited to around 20 minutes in Tuesday's preseason contest against the Lakers and won't travel to Portland for Wednesday's back-to-back against the Trail Blazers, Anthony Slater of ESPN.com reports.

6609.long_comment: Middleton is being eased into action to begin the year. His status remains up in the air for Saturday's exhibition.
6609.name: Khris Middleton
6609.short_comment: Middleton (rest) is trending in the right direction for Saturday's preseason game against Detroit, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.
